stated_where: SI p.7 Scheme S2 and its caption: 'There are 16 series, each series contains 18 lipidoids and in total 288 lipidoids are present in the library.' 4 thiolactones x 4 disulfides = 16; 16 x 18 = 288.
why: 4 x 4 = 16 backbone combinations are fully determined, but only 2 of the 18 amines are. 16 x 2 = 32.
